name: Rugby Tamil Cornerstone Church of God

weekly.title: Sunday – Tamil Worship Service
weekly.description: Join us for a time of worship, praise, prayer, and the teaching of God’s Word in Tamil. We gather as a church family to glorify the Lord Jesus Christ, grow in faith, and encourage one another in His love.

weekly.title: Tuesday – Night Prayer (via Zoom)
weekly.description: Join us online for a dedicated time of prayer for our church. Together, we seek God’s guidance, pray for the growth of His work, and intercede for our church family and its needs.

weekly.title: Thursday – Rugby City Prayer Walk
weekly.description: We walk and pray throughout the streets and areas of Rugby, bringing the town, its residents, families, and communities before the Lord. We pray for God’s protection, peace, and blessing over the city, and against the evil schemes in the city.

monthly.title: Every Third Saturday – Fasting Prayer & Street Evangelism
monthly.time: Every third Saturday of the month | 11:00 am – 1:00 pm
monthly.description: Set apart this time to seek the Lord through worship, His Word, prayer, and fasting. We also seek opportunities to share the love and good news of Jesus Christ with the people of Rugby, trusting God to work in hearts and lives.

monthly.title: Every Third Sunday – Holy Communion Service
monthly.time: Every third Sunday of the month | 4:00 pm – 6:00 pm
monthly.description: Remembering the sacrifice of our Lord Jesus Christ on Calvary and sharing in Holy Communion together as a unified body of believers.
